title: bug: wolfHSM ECDSA_SHA256 sign unguarded size_t cast
description: In wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c:341, wc_Sha256Update receives (word32)inlen without a prior UINT32_MAX guard. On 64-bit targets with inlen>UINT32_MAX the cast silently truncates, producing a hash over fewer bytes than intended -- the signature is computed over the wrong hash. The adjacent CKM_ECDSA path at line 349 correctly guards with UINT16_MAX; ECDSA_SHA256 does not. Same issue at line 448 on the verify path. Fix: add guard matching the soft backend pattern at wp11_backend_soft.c:390.
